text: The UEBA system flagged AGW1590's week (2011-W10) due to elevated file copying to removable media and an unusual spike in overall activity volume. Specifically, AGW1590 copied 12 files to removable media, which is significantly above their typical range of 3 files and the highest in the prior 12 weeks. Additionally, their file operations reached 34, far exceeding their typical range of 14 and the highest in the prior 12 weeks. This level of activity is not only unusual for AGW1590 but also stands out compared to their same-role peers, who averaged only 1 file operation this week.
